==Biography==
Lee "'''Knight'''" Sung-jin is from South Korea. He originally competed under the name '''Loyal''' and later '''LouisXGeeGee'''.
===2014 Season===
Loyal was a substitute AD carry for the [[Jin Air Falcons]] and played in one set of [[PANDORA.TV Champions Winter 2013-2014|Champions Winter 2013-2014]], against the [[Jin Air Stealths]], replacing starting AD carry [[Roar (Oh Jang-won)|Roar]]. The teams split the [[PANDORA.TV Champions Winter 2013-2014/Scoreboards/Group Stage/Group D|series]] 1-1.

===2015 Preseason===
Loyal changed his name to '''Chorong''' and moved to North American to join [[Team Dragon Knights]] in September 2014, with teammates [[Jackpot (American Player)|Jackpot]], [[Miso]], and [[Guardian (American Player)|Guardian]]; shortly thereafter, [[Remilia]] (Yuno) joined the team, and they were to compete in the [[Riot League Championship Series/North America/2015 Season/Spring Expansion|Expansion Tournament]]. However, despite qualifying via the [[Riot League Championship Series/North America/2015 Season/Expansion/Challenger Ladder|ranked 5s ladder]], the team dropped out of competition and did not participate in the Expansion Tournament. Shortly after, they disbanded, and only Chorong remained on the team.
===2015 Season===
Team Dragon Knights was rebuilt in January 2015, and Chorong, now renamed to '''LouisXGeeGee''', was the only member of the team to remain on the roster; [[kina (Shin Woo-yeong)|kina]], [[Kez]], [[Kyle (Seo Ji-seon)|Kyle]], and [[KonKwon]] joined him. This time, the team did compete in the [[2015 NA Challenger Series/Spring Qualifier|NACS Spring Qualifier]], where they successfully defeated [[Team Frostbite]] and then [[Roar (Chinese Team)|Roar]] to qualify for the [[2015 NA Challenger Series/Spring Season|season]]. They placed second overall, with a 7-3 record, sending them to the [[2015 NA Challenger Series/Spring Playoffs|playoffs]]. After a first-round victory against [[Team Fusion]], they lost in the finals 3-1 to [[Enemy eSports]]. Despite the fact that they had placed higher than Fusion, [[Winterfox]] chose to play against them in the [[Riot League Championship Series/North America/2015 Season/Summer Promotion|Summer Promotion Tournament]]. TDK used substitute mid laner [[Alex Ich]] in their promotional matches and won 3-1, successfully qualifying for the [[Riot League Championship Series/North America/2015 Season/Summer Season|NA LCS Summer Split]]. In June he joined [[Team Coast]] as a substitute and changed his role from AD to Mid laner.
===2016 Season ===
LouisXGeeGee renamed to '''Knight''' at the start of the 2016 season, and switched regions again, this time moving to Oceania to play for [[Sentinels Esports Club]] in the [[OCS/2016 Season/Split 1|Oceanic Challenger Series]].

== Trivia ==
* Built [[Essence Reaver]] on {{ci|Sivir}} and {{ci|Lucian}} in [[Team Dragon Knights]]'s first two games against [[Winterfox]] in the [[Riot League Championship Series/North America/2015 Season/Summer Promotion|NA LCS 2015 Summer Promotion Tournament]]; at the time the item had almost never been built in competitive play.
* Changed his legal name from Lee Sung-jin (이성진) to Lee Geon (이건).
